prompts.background: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production 2D side-scrolling game BACKGROUND for Unfin chapter 1 Pencil Forest. Wide panorama 32:9, ideally 3840x1080. Muted warm gray beige paper #BDBCB5, very faint square sketchbook grid and subtle paper grain. Sparse unfinished pencil trees, quiet blank meadow, erased sketch traces, faint distant forest silhouettes. Simple large readable hand-drawn game shapes, monochrome graphite, thin broken decorative lines, low contrast, flat ambient lighting. Horizon at 62% height, lower 30% clear of ground and objects. No foreground terrain, characters, text, UI, borders, photorealism, gradients, pure white, black masses. Seamlessly horizontally repeatable: left/right edges same paper color, identical continuation of grid and faint landscape contours at same heights; no cut trunks at edges. Restrained detail, not a detailed concept painting. Export one opaque background image.
prompts.floor: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production transparent FLOOR terrain strip sprite for Unfin chapter 1 Pencil Forest. Wide horizontal 8:1 composition ideally 4096x512. Orthographic side view. Solid graphite ground mass fills bottom 75% all the way to left, right and bottom image boundaries; top 25% truly transparent air. Continuous slightly organic but nearly level top walkable contour at y=25%, dark ink gray #25272C, smooth antialiased. Ground fill #5E6168, variable 45-degree pencil hatching, matte gray paper texture, sparse erased marks, simple broad forms. Left and right ends must join seamlessly at EXACT same top contour height and fill texture density, no side outlines or end caps, no isolated platform. No stones, trees, grass, characters, text, checkerboard, white background, shadows, perspective or pixel art. Single flat ambient hand-drawn game material, no gradients. Actual alpha transparency.
prompts.ceiling: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production transparent CEILING terrain strip sprite for Unfin chapter 1 Pencil Forest. Wide horizontal 8:1 composition ideally 4096x512. Orthographic side view. Solid graphite ceiling mass fills top 75% all the way to left, right and top image boundaries; bottom 25% truly transparent air. Continuous slightly organic but nearly level underside contour at y=75%, dark ink gray #25272C, smooth antialiased. Ceiling fill #5E6168, variable 45-degree pencil hatching, matte gray paper texture, sparse erased marks, simple broad forms. Left and right ends must join seamlessly at EXACT same underside contour height and fill texture density, no side outlines or end caps, not an isolated floating platform. No roots hanging into air, stalactites, rocks, characters, text, checkerboard, white background, shadows, perspective or pixel art. Single flat ambient hand-drawn game material, no gradients. Actual alpha transparency.

repairs: Edit this background for horizontal seamless tiling. Preserve the pencil forest, muted #BDBCB5 paper, faint grid, simple unfinished sketch style and quiet open composition. Repair ONLY the outer left and right 8% strips: remove trees, clouds, grass and strong marks in those strips, keep a very faint single landscape horizon at exactly 62% of image height on BOTH edges. Edge strips must have matching line density, identical paper brightness and perfectly matching horizontal grid lines. Both edges must connect as one panorama when tiled. Keep center intact. No text, border or foreground ground. Prefer 32:9 aspect ratio.

Repair this horizontal game background's tile seam precisely. Keep middle 70% unchanged. In BOTH outer 15% edge bands remove ALL landscape lines, hills, grass, trees, grid lines and marks. These outer bands must be ONLY the same nearly uniform warm gray beige paper #BDBCB5 with extremely subtle paper grain, NO dark skyline detection anywhere in either band. Blend gently into existing center composition away from edges, no vertical border. Both edges should be visually indistinguishable softly textured blank paper, constant brightness top to bottom. No added text or objects. Maintain full canvas size.
scope: Chapter 1 sample environment; horizontal self-repeat only. Not full zone-link panorama or Unity integration.
limitations: Generated sizes differ from documented 32:9 and 8:1 targets. Background v3 omits grid near edges and is a sample, not approved final production art.
